name: Chronic Recurrent Multifocal Osteomyelitis

criteria.description: Presence of multifocal bone lesions on imaging
Sterile bone biopsy showing chronic inflammation without infection
Recurrent episodes of bone pain lasting weeks to months
Negative microbiological cultures from bone biopsy
Mild to moderate elevation of ESR or CRP
Presence of associated dermatological conditions such as psoriasis or palmoplantar pustulosis

diagnosticCriteria.minimumForDiagnosis: Presence of multifocal bone lesions, sterile bone biopsy showing chronic inflammation, and recurrent bone pain
diagnosticCriteria.notes: Diagnosis is clinical and supported by imaging and biopsy; exclusion of infectious osteomyelitis is essential.

pathognomonic.notes: Typically affects long bones, clavicle, and vertebrae

pathognomonic.symptomName: Sterile bone inflammation confirmed by biopsy

common.symptomName: Associated skin lesions (e.g., psoriasis, palmoplantar pustulosis)

occasional.symptomName: Limited range of motion in affected joints

rare.symptomName: Spinal deformities due to vertebral involvement

laboratory: Mild to moderate elevation of ESR and CRP
Sterile bone biopsy with chronic inflammatory infiltrate
imaging: MRI showing multifocal bone marrow edema and osteitis
X-rays demonstrating lytic and sclerotic bone lesions
Bone scintigraphy revealing multiple active lesions
genetic: Association with mutations in LPIN2, FBLIM1, and other autoinflammatory genes in some cases
other: Exclusion of infectious osteomyelitis and malignancy is critical
Response to NSAIDs and immunomodulatory therapy

distinguishingFeatures: Joint involvement predominates over bone lesions
Presence of systemic symptoms like weight loss

redFlags: Persistent high fever with systemic toxicity
references: Jansson AF, et al. Chronic recurrent multifocal osteomyelitis: clinical presentation and diagnostic criteria. J Rheumatol. 2007.
Ferguson PJ, et al. Autoinflammatory bone disorders. Curr Opin Rheumatol. 2014.
Wipff J, et al. Chronic recurrent multifocal osteomyelitis. Orphanet J Rare Dis. 2015.
